readings.Aries: Your anger is data. What it's pointing at is worth examining before you act on it. Trust the slow version of this over the fast one.
readings.Taurus: You've been working hard for a very long time. That is not the problem. The absence of rest is. Say the thing you've been rehearsing.
readings.Gemini: Your flexibility is a gift to others and sometimes a burden to yourself. Draw a line. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Cancer: The mood has been difficult and you've been managing it alone. That arrangement can change. The window for this is shorter than it looks.
readings.Leo: Your relationships are better when you are being yourself rather than the best version of yourself. This is a better week for listening than speaking.
readings.Virgo: You have been useful to everyone except yourself today. Correct this. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Libra: The injustice that bothers you is not abstract. Name the specific thing. The timing is better than it feels.
readings.Scorpio: The obsession has given you everything it has to give. Release it. What worked before will not work the same way this time.
readings.Sagittarius: You've been framing a limitation as a cage. Most cages are actually just rooms with closed doors. The first instinct was right.
readings.Capricorn: There is a difference between discipline and punishment. Make sure you know which you're practising. Something is about to become obvious.
readings.Aquarius: You've been ahead of the room for so long that you've stopped checking whether the room has caught up. Check. Simpler is correct here.
readings.Pisces: You know the answer. You're waiting to know it more certainly. You won't. Trust what you already know. Someone you haven't thought of lately is relevant to this.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
